'''Jeff Davis Northern CA's Best Deck''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Jeff Davis]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/davisdeck.html Northern CA's Best Deck], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991104015847/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/davisdeck.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jeff Davis]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star|ANH-D-deathstar.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dark Side control
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Davis DS Northern CA Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
[[Jeff Davis]] won the Northern California regional with this deck, winning four times in a row there. It aims to shut down the Light Side's plan and preys on Tatooine decks. The list has 61 cards as published.<ref name="torch" />
